label: semicraspedodromous
definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's secondary branches dividing near the margin, one branch terminating at the margin and the other joining the superadjacent secondary branch. NOTE: Sibling of PATO:0001969 craspedodromous and PATO:0001970 brochidodromous (Hickey 1973); like them it inheres in the leaf.
reason: A standard venation type from leaf architecture with no PATO term; its siblings are already in PATO under branched.
